ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Saakshi uses the camera to record photos and videos for your own records. They are fingerprinted and signed on your phone.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Saakshi records sound with your videos and in bug mode, for your own records.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Saakshi adds where you are to the record of each photo and video, to the alerts you send your trusted contacts, and to live location while you share it.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Saakshi uses your location only while you share live location with your trusted contacts. It never tracks you otherwise.
